title: KB's Kustomz
description: KB's Kustomz is a website built for an automotive body shop specializing in vehicle bodywork and painting. The project focused on creating a professional online presence where prospective customers can learn about the business, explore its services, and view examples of its work.

title: Jarvis Discord Bot
description: A Python-powered Discord bot integrating AI capabilities into Discord communities, providing interactive assistance through the Discord API and Google GenAI API.
